description: Pad-number -> pin-name identity for the non-FPGA ICs of the Rev.0 analog/host chain. This is the schematic-freeze counterpart of pin-plan.json (which freezes the ECP5 BG256 ball identity). Every entry must name the manufacturer document it was taken from; scripts/verify-ic-pinouts.ts refuses a release build while a populated part has no source.

status.pending_scope: empty: 16/16 non-FPGA ICs are audited against a manufacturer document. The 2026-09-12 BEA-52 batch (U_ADCLDO, U_ADC, U_CLK, U_CLKLDO, U_AUXLDO, U_CORE, DS1, U_PPS) closed the pad identity AND replaced the generic footprints with the manufacturer land patterns (src/parts/ic_footprints.tsx).

closure_notes.U_ADCLDO: LT3042EMSE#PBF is the 10-lead MSOP (MSE) + exposed GND pad. The previous model used dfn10 with an invented 1 OUT/2 SENSE/3 SET/4 ILIM/5 IN/6 EN_UV/7 PG/8 GND/9 OUT2/10 PGND map and shorted ILIM to SET. Rewired: IN1/IN2 -> 5V_SYS, EN/UV -> IN, PGFB -> IN, ILIM -> GND (datasheet: tie ILIM to GND when the programmable current limit is unused), PG floating (datasheet: float PG when power-good is unused), SET -> RSET/CSET, OUT/OUTS Kelvin to 3V3_ADC_A, exposed pad -> GND.
closure_notes.U_ADC: LTC1407AIMSE-1#PBF is the 10-lead MSOP (MSE) + exposed GND pad. The previous map had CH1 on pins 3/4, VREF on 5, VDD on 6, GND on 7, CONV/SDO/SCK rotated. Corrected to 1 CH0+, 2 CH0-, 3 VREF, 4 CH1+, 5 CH1-, 6 GND, 7 VDD, 8 SDO, 9 SCK, 10 CONV, 11 exposed pad -> GND.
closure_notes.U_CLK: SiT5356 is a 10-pad 5.0 x 3.2 mm 10L CQFN, not a 4-pad DFN. The previous model had 1 OE / 2 GND / 3 OUT / 4 VDD. Corrected map: 1 OE, 2 SCL/NC, 3 NC, 4 GND, 5 A0/NC, 6 CLK, 7 NC, 8 NC, 9 VDD, 10 SDA/NC; the NC pads follow the datasheet layout guideline to connect the unused pads to the ground plane.
closure_notes.U_CLKLDO: TPS7A2033PDQNR is the 4-pin X2SON (DQN, 1 x 1 mm) option: 1 OUT, 2 GND, 3 EN, 4 IN, 5 thermal pad -> GND. The previous model used the SOT-23-5 (DBV) map and a sot23-5 footprint.
closure_notes.U_AUXLDO: TPS7A2025PDQNR is the same 4-pin X2SON (DQN) option as U_CLKLDO: 1 OUT, 2 GND, 3 EN, 4 IN, 5 thermal pad -> GND. The previous model used the DBV map and a sot23-5 footprint.
closure_notes.U_CORE: TPS628502DRLR is an 8-pin SOT-583 (DRL, 1.60 x 2.10 mm). The previous model used footprinter sot563 (6 pads) with an invented VOS pin and EN on pin 7. Corrected map: 1 VIN, 2 EN, 3 MODE/SYNC, 4 COMP/FSET, 5 FB, 6 PG, 7 SW, 8 GND; the misleading VOS trace was removed and the feedback divider now returns to FB.
closure_notes.DS1: NHD-C0220BiZ-FSW-FBW-3V3M has an 8-pin interface (1 RST, 2 SCL, 3 SDA, 4 VSS, 5 VDD, 6 VOUT, 7 C1+, 8 C1-) plus the module's separate 2-pin backlight connector. The previous model had 7 pads ordered VDD/GND/SDA/SCL/RST/LED_A/LED_K and dropped VOUT/C1+/C1-. The VDD/GND/SDA/SCL/RST nets were remapped onto the real pads, the backlight connector is now the dedicated component J4 (LED_A/LED_K), and the charge-pump capacitors CBST1 (VOUT -> VSS) and CBST2 (C1+ -> C1-) were added.
closure_notes.U_PPS: no orderable MPN was frozen. Rev.0 freezes SN74LVC1G125DBVR (single bus buffer with active-low output enable, SOT-23-5); OE is tied low (permanently enabled), A is the ECP5 PPS_REF input, Y drives PPS_OUT through RPS1, VCC is 3V3_D.

U_BPF.device: LTC1562 / LTC1562A quad universal continuous-time filter
notes: Pins 4, 7, 14 and 17 are substrate/shield connections internally tied to V_MINUS (pin 16) and must be soldered to the same point as pin 16.
Each 2nd-order section is a 3-terminal block: summing node INVx, bandpass output V1x, lowpass output V2x.
Figure 3 / Figure 6a wiring: ZIN (RINx) drives INVx from the source, RQx returns V1x to INVx, R2x returns V2x to INVx. The bandpass output of the cascade is V1x, not V2x.
Single supply: SHDN must be pulled to V_MINUS, never to AGND.
AGND (pin 15) is an internally generated V+/2 reference with ~7 kOhm source impedance; bypass it locally with >= 1 uF.

source.retrieval_method: text proxy (analog.com is unreachable from the build host)
source.retrieved_artifact_kind: plain-text conversion of the 1562fa data sheet
source.evidence: G PACKAGE 20-LEAD PLASTIC SSOP pin configuration table, plus the page-1 typical-application schematic (which omits pins 4, 7, 14, 17 because they are substrate connections)

notes: The GN-16 pinout is NOT the same as the UE12 (12-lead DFN) pinout: on the DFN the package is 1 INA / 2 AGND / 3 INB / 4 CS/LD / 5 DIN / 6 CLK / 7 DOUT / 8 DGND / 9 V+ / 10 OUTB / 11 V- / 12 OUTA with the exposed pad on V-.
Hardware shutdown is available on the GN-16 package only; SHDN is active high and a floating pin defaults to shutdown, so it must be tied to V_MINUS (or 0 V) for normal operation.
Only channel A is populated in Rev.0; INB/OUTB and DOUT stay open.

source.evidence: package/order-information page 2 pin configuration tables (UE12 and GN side by side) and the page-1 typical application 'A Dual, Matched Low Noise PGA (16-Lead SSOP Package)' schematic

U_BUF.device: OPA810 unity-gain-stable JFET-input voltage-feedback op amp
notes: DBV (SOT-23-5) is not the D (SOIC-8) pinout: the SOIC is 1/5/8 NC, 2 VIN-, 3 VIN+, 4 VS-, 6 VO, 7 VS+. On the DBV the five pads are 1 VO, 2 VS-, 3 VIN+, 4 VIN-, 5 VS+.
The part is a single op amp; only the DBV column of Table 5-1 applies to the frozen OPN.
Rev.0 uses it single-supply from 5V_AFE as a follower on the antenna node; V_MINUS is the negative supply and is tied to GND.

source.evidence: Section 5 Pin Configuration and Functions, Figure 5-2 'DBV Package, 5-Pin SOT23 and DCK Package, 5-Pin SC70 (Top View)' plus Table 5-1 Pin Functions DBV column (VO=1, VIN-=4, VIN+=3, VS-=2, VS+=5)

U_DRV.device: OPA2835 dual-channel, ultra-low-power, rail-to-rail output, negative-rail input voltage-feedback op amp
notes: IDGSR is the 10-pin VSSOP (DGS) orderable. The 8-pin SOIC (D) has no PD pins and the QFN/UQFN (RUN/RMC) packages move VS- to pin 5 and PD1 to pin 4.

PD1 (pin 5) and PD2 (pin 6) are active-high shutdown inputs and the data sheet states the pin MUST BE DRIVEN. A floating PD pin is not a valid operating condition, so both are tied to V_PLUS (3V3_ADC_A) for always-on operation.
Channel A is the signal driver and channel B the ADC common-mode buffer, both wired as unity-gain followers.

source.document: OPA835, OPA2835 data sheet, SLOS713J (REVISED MARCH 2021)
source.evidence: Figure 6-3 'OPA2835: DGS Package 10-Pin VSSOP Top View' (1 VOUT1, 2 VIN1-, 3 VIN1+, 4 VS-, 5 PD1, 6 PD2, 7 VIN2+, 8 VIN2-, 9 VOUT2, 10 VS+) cross-checked against Table 6-1 Pin Functions VSSOP column

U_SW.device: TPS22975N 5.7 V, 6 A, 16 mOhm on-resistance load switch without quick-output discharge
U_SW.package: DSG package, 8-pin WSON with exposed thermal pad
notes: DSG (WSON-8) is not a 6-pin SOT-23: the switch input is split across pins 1 and 2, the output across pins 7 and 8, and the exposed centre pad must be tied to GND.
The 'N' variant has no quick-output-discharge FET, which is why it is used here: when PI_3V3 disappears the switch turns off without pulling 5V_SYS down through a discharge device.
ON is active high and must not float; VBIAS is the device bias supply, not the switch input.

source.evidence: Section 6 Pin Configuration and Functions, 'DSG Package 8-Pin (WSON) Top View' (1 VIN, 2 VIN, 3 ON, 4 VBIAS, 5 GND, 6 CT, 7 VOUT, 8 VOUT) plus the Pin Functions table (pin 5 GND, pin 6 CT, pins 1/2 VIN, pins 7/8 VOUT, exposed thermal pad -> GND)

U_FLASH.device: W25Q64JV 64 Mbit serial NOR flash, standard/dual/quad SPI
notes: The 208-mil SOIC (SS) pad map is the frozen one; the 300-mil SOIC, WSON and XSON packages share the same pad order but the land pattern differs.
Rev.0 boots the ECP5 in single-bit Master SPI, so IO2 and IO3 keep their /WP and /HOLD functions and are pulled high through 10 kOhm.

source.evidence: Section 3.1 'Pin Configuration SOIC 208-mil' (Figure 1a, package code SS) with Section 3.3 'Pin Description SOIC 208-mil': 1 /CS, 2 DO (IO1), 3 /WP (IO2), 4 GND, 5 DI (IO0), 6 CLK, 7 /HOLD or /RESET (IO3), 8 VCC

U_EE.device: CAT24C32 32-Kb I2C serial CMOS EEPROM used as the HAT+ ID EEPROM
notes: This freezes the exact orderable MPN that docs/references.md previously listed only as a 'CAT24C32-compatible family' candidate; the SOIC-8 W-suffix pin map above is the one wired in the schematic.
A0/A1/A2 are hard-wired to VSS so the device answers at slave address 0x50, the HAT+ ID EEPROM address.
WP is pulled high through 1 kOhm; the ID bus is supplied from PI_3V3 and never reaches the ECP5.
The UDFN (HU4) option has a different land pattern and no WP pin on the WLCSP 4-ball option, so the package suffix is part of the identity.

source.document: CAT24C32 data sheet (32-Kb I2C CMOS Serial EEPROM), onsemi
source.evidence: Page-2 'PIN CONFIGURATIONS (Top Views)' drawing for 'PDIP (L), SOIC (W), TSSOP (Y), US (US), UDFN (HU4)': left 1 A0, 2 A1, 3 A2, 4 VSS; right 8 VCC, 7 WP, 6 SCL, 5 SDA; plus the 'PIN DESCRIPTION' section

LCD_BLQ.device: BSS138 logic-level N-channel MOSFET, LCD backlight low-side switch
notes: SOT-23 pin 1 is the gate, pin 2 the source and pin 3 the drain, which is the order the backlight low-side switch wiring assumes.
The gate is driven from 3V3_D through RBL2 and held low by RBL3 so the backlight is OFF while the ECP5 is unconfigured or in reset.
VGS(th) is 0.8/1.3/1.5 V, so the 3.3 V gate rail fully enhances the device at the 28 mA backlight current.

source.document: BSS138 data sheet (N-channel logic level MOSFET), onsemi
source.evidence: Page-2 device drawing 'SOT-23-3 CASE 318-08' with the pin callouts 1 Gate / 2 Source / 3 Drain, plus the ordering information row BSS138 SOT-23-3 (Pb-Free)

U_ADCLDO.device: LT3042 20 V, 200 mA, ultralow-noise, ultrahigh-PSRR RF linear regulator
U_ADCLDO.package: MSE package, 10-lead plastic MSOP with exposed GND pad (pin 11), 3 x 3 mm, 0.5 mm pitch
notes: Land pattern: LTC DWG 05-08-1664 Rev I 'MSOP (MSE) RECOMMENDED SOLDER PAD LAYOUT' (pad 1.45 x 0.30 mm at 0.5 mm pitch, exposed pad 1.68 x 1.88 mm); see src/parts/ic_footprints.tsx FP_MSOP10_EP.

The previous Rev.0 model was a 10-pin DFN with an invented 1 OUT/2 SENSE/3 SET/4 ILIM/5 IN/6 EN/UV/7 PG/8 GND/9 OUT2/10 PGND map and tied ILIM to SET, which shorts the current-limit-programming pin to the 100 uA voltage-set node.
ILIM (pin 5) is tied to GND: the data sheet states 'If the programmable current limit functionality is not needed, tie ILIM to GND'. It must never be tied to SET.
PG (pin 4) is left open: the data sheet states 'If the power good functionality is not needed, float the PG pin'.
PGFB (pin 6) is tied to IN: the data sheet states 'If power good and fast start-up functionalities are not needed, tie PGFB to IN'.
EN/UV (pin 3) is tied to IN ('If unused, tie EN/UV to IN. Do not float the EN/UV pin').
OUTS (pin 9) is the Kelvin output-sense return and is tied to the OUT (pin 10) node, which feeds 3V3_ADC_A; SET (pin 7) carries RSET = 33.2 kOhm to GND plus CSET = 4.7 uF, giving 3.32 V.
The exposed pad (pin 11) is an electrical GND and must be soldered to the ground plane and tied to pin 8.

source.retrieval_method: Farnell mirror of the ADI/LTC 3042fa data sheet (analog.com is unreachable from the build host)
source.evidence: 'MSE PACKAGE 10-LEAD PLASTIC MSOP' pin configuration (left 1 IN, 2 IN, 3 EN/UV, 4 PG, 5 ILIM; right 10 OUT, 9 OUTS, 8 GND, 7 SET, 6 PGFB; exposed pad pin 11 is GND) with the PIN FUNCTIONS text for ILIM/PG/PGFB/EN-UV/SET/GND, plus the 'MSE Package 10-Lead Plastic MSOP, Exposed Die Pad' drawing (Reference LTC DWG # 05-08-1664 Rev I)

U_ADC.device: LTC1407A-1 serial 14-bit, 3 Msps, simultaneous-sampling ADC with shutdown
U_ADC.package: MSE package, 10-lead plastic MSOP with exposed GND pad (pin 11), 3 x 3 mm, 0.5 mm pitch
notes: Land pattern: the same MSOP-10 + exposed-pad 'MSE' outline as the LT3042 (LTC DWG 05-08-1664 Rev C, 'MSOP (MSE) 0908', recommended solder pads 1.45 x 0.30 mm at 0.5 mm pitch, exposed pad 1.68 x 1.88 mm); see src/parts/ic_footprints.tsx FP_MSOP10_EP.
The previous Rev.0 map placed CH1 on pins 3/4, VREF on 5, VDD on 6, GND on 7 and rotated CONV/SCK/SDO, so every analog and digital net was on the wrong pad.
The exposed pad is GND (pin 11) and must be soldered to the PCB; the reference bypass and the ADC ground return are taken at the exposed pad.
Channel 0 is the receive path; channel 1 stays free for the band-pass diagnostic tap.

source.retrieval_method: Farnell mirror of the ADI/LTC 14071fb data sheet (analog.com is unreachable from the build host)

U_CLK.device: SiT5356 Stratum 3 Elite precision super-TCXO, 25 MHz LVCMOS
notes: Land pattern: SiTime solder-print SPL-001-RevA (overall land 4.050 x 2.350 mm, side-pad width 0.700 mm) on the 'Package Outline PQD-CQFN-10-050302-036' 10L CQFN; see src/parts/ic_footprints.tsx FP_TCXO_5032_10.
The previous Rev.0 model was a 4-pad dfn4 with 1 OE / 2 GND / 3 OUT / 4 VDD, which renumbers the real part: OE is pin 1, GND is pin 4, CLK is pin 6 and VDD is pin 9.

The 'FQ' order code selects pin 1 as OE and pins 2/5/10 as NC (no I2C/VCTCXO). The data-sheet layout guideline 'connect all NC pins to the ground plane' is applied: pins 2, 3, 5, 7, 8 and 10 are tied to GND.
Pin 1 (OE) has an internal pull-up to VDD; Rev.0 ties it to 3V3_CLK for an always-enabled output. The data sheet recommends a <= 10 kOhm pull-up if the pin is not externally driven.
VDD decoupling is the data-sheet requirement of 0.1 uF (CCLK1, within 1-2 mm of VDD) in parallel with 10 uF on the rail.

source.document: SiT5356 1 MHz - 60 MHz, +-0.1 to +-0.25 ppm, Stratum 3 Elite Platform Precision Super-TCXO data sheet, Rev 1.08 (January 2023)
source.evidence: '5.0 mm x 3.2 mm Package Pinout / Figure 2. Pin Assignments (Top view)' with pins 1 OE/VC/NC, 2 SCL/NC, 3 NC, 4 GND, 5 A0/NC, 6 CLK, 7 NC, 8 NC, 9 VDD, 10 SDA/NC; 'Dimensions and Patterns -> Package Size - Dimensions / Recommended Land Pattern' (SPL-001-RevA, 10L Ceramic 5.0 x 3.2 x 0.95); 'Layout Guidelines' (connect all NC pins to the ground plane, 0.1 uF close to VDD)

U_CLKLDO.device: TPS7A20 ultra-low-noise, 300 mA low-dropout regulator, 3.3 V fixed
U_CLKLDO.package: DQN package, 4-pin X2SON (1 x 1 mm) with exposed thermal pad (DRAWN AS PIN 5)
notes: Land pattern: TI 4215302/E (DQN0004A) 'EXAMPLE BOARD LAYOUT' - 4 signal pads 0.21 x 0.36 mm on a 0.86 x 0.65 mm grid plus the exposed thermal pad; see src/parts/ic_footprints.tsx FP_X2SON4_EP.

The previous Rev.0 model used the SOT-23-5 (DBV) map (1 IN, 2 GND, 3 EN, 4 NC, 5 OUT) and a sot23-5 footprint. DQN and DBV are different packages with different pin maps in the same family, so the frozen PDQNR order code must use the X2SON map.
The thermal pad is drawn as pin 5 in the data-sheet figure and must be soldered to GND for mechanical and thermal performance.

source.document: TPS7A20 data sheet, SBVS338H (MARCH 2020 - REVISED JULY 2024)
source.evidence: 'Figure 4-3. DQN Package, 4-Pin X2SON (Top View)' (1 OUT, 2 GND, 3 EN, 4 IN, 5 Thermal Pad) cross-checked against the 'Pin Functions: X2SON, SOT-23' table (IN = 4, OUT = 1, EN = 3, GND = 2), plus the 'DQN0004A X2SON - 0.4 mm max height' package outline and 'EXAMPLE BOARD LAYOUT' (TI 4215302/E)

U_AUXLDO.device: TPS7A20 ultra-low-noise, 300 mA low-dropout regulator, 2.5 V fixed
U_AUXLDO.package: DQN package, 4-pin X2SON (1 x 1 mm) with exposed thermal pad (DRAWN AS PIN 5)
notes: Same DQN (X2SON-4) package and land pattern as U_CLKLDO; see src/parts/ic_footprints.tsx FP_X2SON4_EP.
The previous Rev.0 model used the SOT-23-5 (DBV) map and footprint; the frozen PDQNR order code is the 4-pin X2SON option.
This rail is supplied from 3V3_D and feeds the ECP5 VCCAUX, so the enable input is tied to its own input rail.

source.document: TPS7A20 data sheet, SBVS338H (MARCH 2020 - REVISED JULY 2024)
source.evidence: The same 'Figure 4-3. DQN Package, 4-Pin X2SON (Top View)' and 'Pin Functions: X2SON, SOT-23' table used for U_CLKLDO; the DQN pin map is package-defined and identical for every TPS7A20 fixed-output option.

U_CORE.device: TPS628502 2 A, 2.7 V to 6 V step-down converter with adjustable switching frequency
U_CORE.package: DRL package, 8-pin SOT-583 (1.60 x 2.10 mm), 0.5 mm pitch
notes: Land pattern: TI 4224486/G (DRL0008A) 'EXAMPLE BOARD LAYOUT' - 8 pads 0.67 x 0.30 mm on a 1.48 mm x 0.5 mm-pitch grid; see src/parts/ic_footprints.tsx FP_SOT583_8.
The previous Rev.0 model used footprinter sot563 (6 pads) with an invented VOS pin and EN on pin 7; there is no VOS pin on this device, EN is pin 2 and the switch node is pin 7.
MODE/SYNC (pin 3) is pulled high through 10 kOhm for forced-PWM operation and must not float.
COMP/FSET (pin 4) takes RFSET to GND (5.76 kOhm), which sets the compensation and the switching frequency.
FB (pin 5) takes the 39.2 kOhm / 47.0 kOhm divider plus the 10 pF feed-forward capacitor to the 1V1_CORE node. The bogus 'VOS' trace to the output rail was deleted.
PG (pin 6) is an open-drain power-good output and is left open in Rev.0.
This is the sole local switching regulator and lives in the digital region only.

source.document: TPS628501, TPS628502, TPS628503 data sheet, SLUSEC8C (MARCH 2021 - REVISED JUNE 2025)
source.evidence: 'Figure 5-1. 8-Pin SOT583 DRL Package (Top View)' with Table 5-1 Pin Functions (EN = 2, FB = 5, GND = 8, MODE/SYNC = 3, COMP/FSET = 4, PG = 6, SW = 7, VIN = 1), plus the 'SOT-5X3 DRL0008A' package outline and 'EXAMPLE BOARD LAYOUT' (TI 4224486/G)

DS1.device: Newhaven 2x20 character COG LCD module, ST7036i controller, I2C, white LED backlight
DS1.package: COG module 75.7 x 27.1 mm; 8-pad interface row on a 2.0 mm pitch, plus a separate 2-pin backlight connector (modelled as J4)
notes: Land pattern: Newhaven 'Recommended PCB Footprint' for NHD-C0220BiZ - eight interface pads at P2.0*7 = 14 mm, pad 0.5 x 0.3 mm; see src/parts/ic_footprints.tsx FP_LCD_8PIN.
The previous Rev.0 model had 7 pads ordered VDD/GND/SDA/SCL/RST/LED_A/LED_K: every signal net was on the wrong pad and VOUT/C1+/C1- were missing.

The module's backlight is a *separate* two-pin connector ('Backlight connector: 8.5 mm pitch pins, solder directly into PCB'); it is modelled as the dedicated component J4 (LED_A / LED_K) with its own footprint FP_BL_2PIN, not as extra pins on DS1.
The ST7036i charge-pump needs CBST1 = 1 uF from VOUT (pin 6) to VSS and CBST2 = 1 uF between C1+ (pin 7) and C1- (pin 8); the data sheet allows 0.47 uF .. 2.2 uF and recommends 1 uF.
The module is soldered directly to the PCB (no mating connector) and overhangs the HAT+ outline; it is a locked mechanical constraint.

source.evidence: 'Pin Description' table (1 RST, 2 SCL, 3 SDA, 4 VSS, 5 VDD, 6 VOUT, 7 C1+, 8 C1-; VOUT 'Connect 0.47 uF~2.2 uF cap to VSS or VDD'; C1+ 'Connect 1 uF cap to PIN8'; 'Backlight connector: 8.5 mm pitch pins, solder directly into PCB'), the mechanical drawing pin callouts on page 4, and the 'Recommended PCB Footprint' drawing on page 5

U_PPS.device: SN74LVC1G125 single bus buffer gate with 3-state output and active-low output enable
notes: This freezes the MPN that docs/references.md previously left unassigned ('only the ECP5 ball and output path are frozen').
OE (pin 1) is active low and is tied to GND so the buffer is permanently enabled; the ECP5 PPS_REF signal drives A (pin 2) and Y (pin 4) drives PPS_OUT through RPS1 = 33 Ohm.
VCC (pin 5) is 3V3_D so the PPS output swings in the digital I/O domain; the data sheet requires the 100 nF decoupling at the device.

The data sheet notes that when the output is disabled or the device is powered down, OE must be tied to VCC through a pull-up; tying it permanently to GND for an always-on buffer is the equivalent always-enabled configuration and is the Rev.0 intent.

source.document: SN74LVC1G125 data sheet, SCES223U (APRIL 1999 - REVISED AUGUST 2026)
source.evidence: '4 Pin Configuration and Functions - DBV PACKAGE (TOP VIEW)' (1 OE, 2 A, 3 GND, 4 Y, 5 VCC) plus the functional description 'the output is disabled when the output-enable (OE) input is high; when OE is low, true data is passed from the A input to the Y output'
